title: Report of Stage 6, Integration (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/integration.json, not committed)
description: Protocol §5, Stage 6, the part that fits in the provider repo's binary. Declared blast radius: the changed files from base to candidate that match the contracts of each consumer of config.integration. Consumer-driven contract matrix: each affected consumer runs its suite, without network, against the candidate in /work; a red one rejects (escalation consumer_broken). Expand-and-contract: the changed migration files go through the destructive DDL linter (escalation destructive_migration). verdict: PASS if every affected consumer passed and there is no destructive DDL; FAIL if a consumer broke or there is destructive DDL; INCONCLUSIVE if some run could not be judged. Outside the binary: the service graph and the durable contract workflow.

candidate.description: The commit of the candidate left by Stage 3 (the one selected with N=2); null if the working tree was judged.

affected_by.description: Changed files that match its contracts. Empty with status not_run: nothing of its changed. Empty with another status: the consumer declares no contracts and runs on every slice.

status.description: passed: its suite green against the candidate. failed: at least one red test (failed_tests). inconclusive: the run could not be judged (reason). not_run: no changed file matches its contracts.

files.description: Changed files that match config.integration.migrations.paths and went through the linter.

rule.description: drop_column (also ALTER TABLE … DROP <col> without COLUMN), drop_table, rename, type_change, truncate, or custom:<n> for a config rule. It is a per-statement regular-expression linter (quoted literals excluded), not squawk or atlas over a snapshot: that is left to the platform.

discovered.description: Edges found inside the repo (blast radius): Python imports via AST, TypeScript via the compiler, OpenAPI or protobuf contracts to their clients, and Code Graph Indexer edges (ChronosGraph). Cross-repo consumers stay in config.integration.

blast_radius.description: Downstream impact and risk score measured by the Code Graph Indexer (ChronosGraph).
